title: specs/fsd/<doc>/rulings.yaml: the PM's rulings on the FSD review (contract rulings v2, D361, D363, D365, D366, D386)
description: Written by `stangent fsd rulings` from review.json, grouped by FSD section; the PM edits only `ruling`, `statement`, `pmNote` and a section's `matches`, and deletes `flagged` or `new` lines once they have looked. Who ruled and when come from git blame on the `ruling` (or `matches`) line, never from the file. Values per state are checked by `stangent fsd rulings-check`.

key.description: A gap, conflict or match by its section's permanent id and its quote (normalized as the review's merge joins quotes); undocumented code by its D362 link, with its section when it has one.

hash.description: The fingerprint of what it links to when last refreshed (D362 (2)).

runs.description: The review runs that found it.

confidence.description: A match only (D366 (4)): high when every run found it and it links to a flow or a screen, medium for one of those, low for neither.

disagrees.description: One run called this statement a match, another a gap or conflict; the difference is what is ruled.

notes.description: The review's words, for the PM.

notFound.description: The review commit whose runs no longer found it; kept because it holds a ruling (D363).

flagged.description: Why the PM should look again (its link changed, its section changed, its state changed). The PM deletes the line.

new.description: A match added after its section's matches were confirmed. The PM deletes the line, or rules it.

writtenFrom.description: A ruling written into the FSD (D386, `stangent fsd write`): the entry is now a confirmed match on the new sentence, and this names what it replaced. state and quote (or link, for code no section covered) are the old entry's key; ruling is code-right or restated; statement the PM's words for restated; by and on who ruled, from git blame when the ruling was committed before it was written (null when the commit of the write is the ruling).

cites.description: code-right: the code lines the AI's new words describe, checked by `fsd write-check`.

jira.description: Where the ruling came from when drafted from a Jira `Ruling:` reply (D364, layer 5).

ruling.description: The PM's: code-right, fsd-right or restated (gap, conflict); keep, remove or restated (undocumented); confirmed or not-a-match (match). Null until ruled.

statement.description: The rule in the PM's words; required for restated.

review.description: The review.json the last refresh read.

textHash.description: The section's own text when last refreshed: a change drops its rulings to blank (an entry whose quote, perhaps from a subsection, is no longer in the section's text is dropped too).

matches.description: The PM's one confirmation of the section's matches: confirmed, or null.

undocumented.description: Code no section covers, by link.
